texture analysis of breast thermogram using NGTDM and RLM is computationally inexpensive, efficient and can be used for early detection and diagnosis of breast cancer.
texture features extracted from NGTDM and RLM are computationally efficient and attained an average classification accuracy of 80% in the detection of breast cancer from thermograms.
NGTDM and RLM features are found to be statistically significant for the detection of breast cancer and the extracted features are computationally efficient.

the development of an automated computer-aided system for detection of breast cancer based on texture features.
the extraction of significant texture features for computer aided detection of breast cancer from breast thermograms using NGTDM and RLM.
the extraction of features from breast thermograms using NGTDM and RLM.
